description: Check or cancel an asynchronous crawl job created by web_crawl_async. When to use: after web_crawl_async, poll with action=status until status is done/failed/cancelled; use action=cancel to stop a running job. Do not use: to start a crawl (web_crawl_async) or for a quick one-page read (web_fetch). Returns status: {ok, job_id, status: queued|running|done|failed|cancelled, progress:{pages_done,max_pages}, created_at, updated_at, result?, error?}. Free (not metered); rate-limited. Done result uses the same shape as web_crawl.

action.description: Poll status (default) or cancel the job.

name: web_crawl_job
title: Web Crawl Job
